```{=html}
<style>
.insta-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 3px;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.insta-grid .quarto-figure,
.insta-grid figure {
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  position: relative;
}

.insta-grid p {
  margin: 0;
  height: 100%;
}

.insta-grid img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease, filter 0.25s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.insta-grid a:hover img,
.insta-grid figure:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.06);
  filter: brightness(1.15) saturate(1.2);
}

.insta-grid .figure-caption {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  padding: 1.5rem 0.6rem 0.5rem;
  background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72));
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  text-align: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.insta-grid figure:hover .figure-caption {
  opacity: 1;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .insta-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}
</style>
```
